# Import

```{r import}
df.raw <- read.csv('Life Expectancy Data.csv')
```

# Data cleaning

```{r cleaning}
# Drop rows with NAs (few exist) and remove all outliers
df <- na.omit(df.raw)

# Identify outliers with the 1.5 * IQR rule
is_outlier <- function(x) {
  q <- quantile(x, probs = c(0.25, 0.75), na.rm = TRUE)
  iqr <- IQR(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  x < (q[1] - 1.5 * iqr) | x > (q[2] + 1.5 * iqr)
}

numeric_cols <- sapply(df, is.numeric)
outlier_rows <- apply(sapply(df[, numeric_cols], is_outlier), 1, any)

cat("Rows before removing outliers:", nrow(df), "\n")
cat("Rows with outliers removed:", sum(outlier_rows), "\n")
df <- df[!outlier_rows, ]
cat("Rows remaining:", nrow(df), "\n")
```

# Categorical variables

Only `Country` and `Status` are categorical.

```{r categorical-country}
## countries
country_freq_table <- table(df$Country)
plot(country_freq_table)
```

```{r categorical-status}
## status
status_freq_table <- table(df$Status)
plot(status_freq_table)
```

# Numerical variables

```{r numeric-cols}
(numeric.cols <- df[, sapply(df, is.numeric)])
```

```{r numeric-scatterplots}
lapply(names(numeric.cols), function(column_name) {
  plot(numeric.cols[[column_name]],
       numeric.cols$Life.expectancy,
       xlab = column_name,
       ylab = "Life Expectancy")
})
```

`percentage.expenditure` and `GDP` can be log transformed.

# Log transformations

```{r log-percentage-expenditure}
plot(
  Life.expectancy ~ percentage.expenditure,
  data = df,
  main = "Percentage Expenditure (Non-transformed) vs Life Expectancy",
  xlab = "Percentage Expenditure",
  ylab = "Life Expectancy"
)

plot(
  Life.expectancy ~ log(percentage.expenditure),
  data = df,
  main = "Percentage Expenditure (Log transformed) vs Life Expectancy",
  xlab = "log(Percentage Expenditure)",
  ylab = "Life Expectancy"
)
```

```{r log-gdp}
plot(
  Life.expectancy ~ GDP,
  data = df,
  main = "GDP (Non-transformed) vs Life Expectancy",
  xlab = "GDP",
  ylab = "Life Expectancy"
)

plot(
  Life.expectancy ~ I(log(GDP)),
  data = df,
  main = "GDP (Log transformed) vs Life Expectancy",
  xlab = "log(GDP)",
  ylab = "Life Expectancy"
)
```

# Regression models (comparing transformations)

```{r lm-p.exp}
lm.percentage.expenditure.nontrans <- lm(Life.expectancy ~ percentage.expenditure, data = df)
summary(lm.GDP.nontrans)

lm.percentage.expenditure.trans <- lm(Life.expectancy ~ I(log(percentage.expenditure)), data = df)
summary(lm.GDP.trans)

```

```{r lm-gdp}
lm.GDP.nontrans <- lm(Life.expectancy ~ GDP, data = df)
summary(lm.GDP.nontrans)

lm.GDP.trans <- lm(Life.expectancy ~ I(log(GDP)), data = df)
summary(lm.GDP.trans)
```
